items.title: ExxonMobil Announces First-Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: ExxonMobil said first-quarter 2026 earnings were $7.7 billion a year earlier; cash capital expenditures totaled $6.2 billion, consistent with full-year guidance range of $27-$29 billion.
